description: Anchor texts of the links to a domain, most used first: each anchor's backlinks, referring domains and main domains, nofollow domains and first seen, up to 100 rows per $0.048 call, from a web link index. Use when checking anchor-text distribution or over-optimisation. Anchors are the linking pages' own text. No links is an empty answer, which is still charged. Bad input is a free 400; a data source failure is not charged. Price: $0.048 per successful call, paid over x402 (USDC on Base); pass the payment in _meta["x402/payment"].

target.description: A domain like example.com (subdomains allowed). A site-root URL such as https://www.example.com/ is reduced to the domain; a path or port is refused.
